notes:
WHAT CHANGED IN THIS EDIT (read first). Only the four film ad groups were touched - EN PPF Film Rolls, EN Window Film Rolls, AR PPF Film Rolls, AR Window Film Rolls. The other six ad groups (wholesale hub, become-a-dealer, bulk shampoo, in both languages) are carried over byte-identical: same keywords, same negatives, same ad copy, same paths, same bids. Do not diff-review them; they did not change.

NEW FINAL URLS. The two dead vertek-* film slugs are replaced by the shipped VTEK SKUs. PPF ad groups now point at /b2b/products/vtek-ppf-weather-armor-ultimate and tint ad groups at /b2b/products/vtek-window-tints, in both /en/ and /ar/. Verify all four return 200 before import - a 404 Final URL is an instant disapproval.

SPEC CLAIMS ARE BACK, AND THEY ARE SOURCED. A previous revision stripped every number from these ad groups because the products were not deployed. They are deployed now, so the ads state exactly what the shipped spec sheet states and nothing more. PPF ULTIMATE: Advanced Polycarbonate TPU, 8.5 mil (215 um), Ultra-Gloss High Depth, Instant Heat Self-Healing and Hydrophobic Top-Coat, 10-Year Manufacturer Warranty, resistance to extreme UV, desert sand, road salts and chemicals. Window film: Iconic and Indulge series, up to 65% TSER, 90%+ IR rejection, 99% UV rejection, 10-Year e-Warranty, Qatar Traffic Law and MOI Compliant Grades. No film width, no roll length, no price, no lead time - none of that is published. If the spec sheet in src/data/products.ts changes, these two ad groups change with it.

BRAND TOKEN CONFLICT - OPERATOR MUST DECIDE. The deployed catalogue has zero products under brand 'Vertek'; all five film SKUs are brand 'VTEK'. The four film ad groups now say VTEK in ad text, with 'vertek' and 'v-tek' kept as KEYWORDS ONLY so buyers who met the old spelling still match (the old slugs 308-redirect). BUT the six untouched ad groups still say 'Vertek' in their ad copy - 'Autotriz & Vertek Stocked', 'Autotriz, Vertek and Briller stocked in Mesaimeer', 'Autotriz & Vertek Dealers', 'Sell Autotriz, Vertek and Briller in your market', 'منتجات Autotriz و Vertek', 'وزع أفلام Vertek للحماية', 'منتجات Autotriz و Vertek و Briller'. That was a deliberate instruction to leave those six byte-identical, so the account will ship with mixed VTEK/Vertek branding. This is inconsistent and should be resolved in a follow-up pass that rewrites those six assets to VTEK. Until then, expect a reviewer to ask why the wholesale-hub ad says Vertek while the PPF ad says VTEK.

TINT LEGALITY - NARROW CLAIM ONLY. The live product page states 'Qatar Traffic Law & MOI Compliant Grades', so the ads now say 'MOI Compliant Grades' (EN) and 'درجات متوافقة مع أنظمة قطر' (AR). That is the whole claim: grades exist that suit the regulations. No ad states a VLT percentage, and no ad says or implies that any grade is legal on any particular window. The 65% TSER, 90%+ IR and 99% UV figures are performance numbers off the spec sheet, not legality numbers - do not let anyone 'simplify' them into a tint-darkness claim. Every legality query stays a negative in both the ad groups and the shared list (tint law, legal tint, tint limit, tint permit, vlt percentage, تصريح تظليل, نسبة التظليل, التظليل المسموح, مخالفة/غرامة تظليل), because this campaign runs in six countries with different rules and ABK cannot answer a regulation question for a buyer's customer.

NEGATIVES REMOVED ON PURPOSE. 'ppf warranty', 'ppf thickness' and 'mil ppf' were shared negatives, and 'ضمان فيلم الحماية' was both a shared negative and an AR PPF ad-group negative. All four are GONE. They existed only because the old landing page stated no thickness and no warranty term; the new page states 8.5 mil and a 10-year manufacturer warranty, so a buyer searching those terms is now exactly the buyer this ad group wants. 'ppf warranty claim' is kept as an EN PPF ad-group negative to block existing-customer support traffic. If you ever roll the film ad groups back to a page without those specs, put all four negatives back first.

SERVICE LANGUAGE. ABK sells product and performs no installation, tinting, coating, polishing or detailing. No ad promises fitting, booking or an appointment. Because this audience does its own application, the EN film ads use 'We Supply, You Fit' and 'Supply for PPF Installers' - both assign the work to the BUYER. Correct here; must NOT be copied into the B2C campaigns. The Arabic side avoids تركيب entirely, even buyer-assigned: 'نورد الفيلم فقط وفنيو ورشتك هم من ينفذون العمل' says the same thing without the token, so an Arabic reviewer scanning for تركيب finds nothing in ad text.

NO PHONE NUMBER, NO PRICES. No ad text contains a phone number - Google disallows it; the number belongs in a campaign-level Call asset. No ad states a price, discount or 'best price'; the site publishes none for these SKUs and the offer is a wholesale list over WhatsApp. 'Trade Price List on WhatsApp' / 'أسعار الجملة على واتساب' names the mechanism only and is the single asset family containing the word price.

WHY ULTIMATE AND NOT THE OTHER THREE PPF SKUS. PRO (7.5 mil, 8-year), MATTE (8 mil satin, 10-year) and PRISM (colour, 8.5 mil, 8-year) are all live, but one ad group takes one Final URL and ULTIMATE is the flagship a trade buyer benchmarks on. The 'matte ppf film supplier' and 'gloss ppf film supplier' keywords stay in the ULTIMATE ad group because the landing page carries the range navigation - but the strongest expansion available now is to split MATTE and PRISM into their own ad groups (colour PPF in particular has near-zero Gulf competition and six named colours to build headlines from). Do that before adding more keywords to this one.

SCOPE AND GEO. B2B wholesale / dealer-recruitment theme only. Geo is six countries, so the Qatar-only geo-leakage negatives used by the B2C themes (dubai, riyadh, kuwait, bahrain, muscat, jeddah, dammam) MUST NOT be applied here - they would block this campaign's core markets. Set location options to 'Presence: people in your targeted locations', not 'presence or interest', or Indian and Pakistani research traffic leaks in.

SHARED NEGATIVES - three deliberate omissions. (1) The bare words 'service' and 'services' are NOT in the shared list even though ABK performs none: the legal name is 'ABK Trading & Service', so an account-level 'service' negative would kill brand search if a brand campaign is ever added. (2) The Arabic phrase 'تظليل سيارات' is NOT a shared negative - it is a substring of the AR window-film ad group's best keyword 'رول تظليل سيارات'. Only service collocations (تركيب تظليل, محل تظليل, تظليل متنقل) are blocked. (3) The bare word 'مركز' is never used: Google Ads ignores Arabic diacritics, so مركز (centre) and مركّز (concentrate) collapse to one token and a bare negative would suppress 'شامبو سيارات مركز', a core B2B shampoo query. Likewise 'وكيل' is negative because in Gulf car context it means a vehicle dealership agent, not a distributor.

MATCH TYPES. All positive keywords are Phrase or Exact - no broad, no legacy '+' modified broad. All negatives, ad-group and shared, are listed as Broad in this file; add them in Google Ads as PHRASE match. 'armor all' in particular must be phrase - as a broad negative it would block 'VTEK PPF Weather Armor' and 'VTEK Solar Armor'. 'noon' must be phrase for the same reason. Google does not apply close-variant matching to negatives, so 'installation' will not block the intentional positive 'ppf film supplier for installers'.

JUDGEMENT CALLS A REVIEWER SHOULD DOUBLE-CHECK.
1. 'We Supply, You Fit' (EN, both film ad groups) is the one place an English ad contains a fitting verb, assigned explicitly to the buyer. It is the strongest differentiator ABK has. For zero tolerance, swap for 'We Supply, You Apply', already used in the EN wholesale ad group.
2. GCC supply is claimed because public/llms.txt states wholesale across the GCC. No asset promises shipping, lead times or delivery. Confirm ABK actually ships cross-border before spending in the five non-Qatar markets; if it does not, cut locations to Qatar and drop the ...uae / ...saudi arabia / ...kuwait / ...bahrain keywords in every ad group.
3. 'Made in Canada' appears only in the Briller wash-chemicals ad group. It must never drift onto an Autotriz (Germany) or VTEK asset - VTEK origin is not published.
4. Friday is paused because the store is closed and the conversion is a human WhatsApp reply. This costs UAE and Saudi reach: the UAE business week is Mon-Fri and Saudi's weekend is Fri-Sat. If the owner will answer WhatsApp on Fridays, unpause Friday for this campaign only - it is the one campaign where the buyer is at work on a Friday.
5. Bid strategy is 'Maximize conversions' for consistency with the sibling campaigns, but this campaign has no conversion history. Recommend Maximize clicks with the per-ad-group max CPC caps for the first 30 days, then switch once 15-30 WhatsApp conversions have accrued.
6. 'nano ceramic window film supplier' and 'ceramic tint film wholesale' are new keywords. They are supported by the product's own description ('nano-ceramic window films' in the shipped short description), not by the specs line. If a reviewer wants strict specs-only sourcing, cut those two - the TSER / IR / UV assets do not depend on them.
7. The AR headline 'حجب 99% للأشعة فوق البنفسجية' is 28 characters and the AR description carrying Iconic and Indulge is 88 - both near the limit. Re-count before any wording tweak.

PRE-LAUNCH. (a) Verify all four new film Final URLs return 200 in both languages. (b) Force a Google re-crawl of /en/b2b and /ar/b2b - the index may still carry stale copy naming Insta Finish and Getsun, which the owner has pulled. (c) Final URLs must be an abktradingservice.com page carrying the WhatsApp button - a wa.me link cannot be a Final URL. Add a campaign-level Call asset for the phone number, plus a Location asset and Business Hours reflecting Sat-Thu 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-22:00, Friday closed. (d) Proof every Arabic asset in a real RTL preview, not a code editor: no headline starts with a Latin token or a digit, no terminal punctuation, no em-dash, Western digits only, tashkeel stripped. Pay particular attention to the assets that embed a Latin token mid-string (فيلم حماية الطلاء VTEK, أفلام تظليل VTEK, سلسلتا Iconic و Indulge, عزل حراري حتى 65% TSER, VTEK Weather Armor, VTEK Solar Armor). (e) Google Shopping and Merchant Center do not support Qatar but do support UAE, Saudi, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman, so a feed play is possible on the B2B side only if cross-border fulfilment is confirmed (see call 2).
